source.terms_note: Author dataset card states 'Google Youtube Fair Use License'; no media is redistributed here.

selection.rule: Deduplicate (source_file, start, end); sort by SHA-256 of source_file:start_6dp:end_6dp; take the first 50. For duplicate intervals, retain the lowest numeric question ID.
selection.scope: One topic: 3D printing. A deterministic smoke test, not a representative benchmark sample.

method.grid: Analytical windows [k * stride, k * stride + width], integer k >= 0, anchored at source time zero; no trimming at an unknown media end.
method.iou: Maximum intersection-over-union between the labeled interval and any single grid window.
method.containment: Whether at least one single grid window contains the complete labeled interval.
method.coverage: Minimum number of grid windows whose union covers the complete labeled interval, chosen with oracle access to that interval.
method.overlap_cost: Width / stride is a theoretical asymptotic multiplier for indexed window-seconds. It is not a measured corpus cost or duplicate-seconds total.
method.limits: No media, model, retrieval, ranking, answers, or acoustic boundaries are evaluated. Labels are used as supplied and may be approximate. Results cannot establish an optimal chunk size.
